name: Marrakech
tagline: Ancient Medina Magic, Stunning Riads, and Extraordinary Value
description: Marrakech is a sensory feast that offers FIRE retirees an incredibly affordable, culturally immersive lifestyle. The ancient medina, Atlas Mountain backdrop, and world-renowned food scene create a daily experience unlike anywhere else on earth. Housing costs are remarkably low, especially for the quality of traditional riad living. French is the primary second language, though English is growing in tourist areas. The city attracts a large international expat community, modern private healthcare is available, and Morocco offers a straightforward long-stay visa process for retirees.

quickFacts.visa: 90-day visa-free for US citizens. 1-year renewable residence permit available with proof of financial means (pension, investments, or passive income). No formal retirement visa but residency process is retiree-friendly.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Good – low violent crime; petty theft in tourist areas
quickFacts.climate: Arid semi-desert with hot dry summers and mild winters

housing.description: Modest 1BR in Gueliz or a small renovated riad room in the medina

dining.description: Local tagine/couscous joints a few times a week; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: Basic local private cover, single adult 45–55

transportation.description: Petit taxis and walking; no car

1M.lifestyle: A plain but decent 1BR in Gueliz, walkable to cafés and the market, or a modestly done-up room in a medina riad. Most meals come from souk produce cooked at home, with local tagine and couscous joints for eating out a few times a week and café afternoons that cost almost nothing. Petit taxis and your own two feet cover transport — no car needed. Health cover is a basic local private policy that gets you into private clinics for routine care. Frugal but genuinely comfortable, and French is essential for daily life.

housing.description: Nicer furnished 1BR in Gueliz/Hivernage or a comfortable riad

dining.description: Out several times a week, local + mid-range

healthcare.description: Comprehensive local private cover, single adult

transportation.description: Petit taxis routinely plus occasional car hire

2M.lifestyle: A properly furnished, air-conditioned 1BR in Gueliz or Hivernage, or a comfortable riad in the medina. Dining out several nights a week is unremarkable, mixing local spots with mid-range restaurants, and comprehensive local private insurance covers Marrakech's private clinics well. Getting around is petit taxis routinely, plus the occasional rental car for excursions to the Atlas or the coast. A gym membership, cinema, and nightlife fill out an easy solo life.

housing.description: Premium furnished 1BR or compact 2BR-for-one in Hivernage/Gueliz or a well-restored riad

dining.description: Frequent quality dining including Marrakech's better restaurants

healthcare.description: Strong private cover approaching an international plan

transportation.description: A small owned car or effectively unlimited taxis

entertainment.description: Quality leisure plus amortized weekend/European travel

3M.lifestyle: A high-spec furnished 1BR or compact 2BR-for-one in Hivernage or Gueliz, or a beautifully restored riad in a sought-after quarter. Eating at the city's best restaurants becomes a regular habit, and you either run a small car or take petit and grand taxis at will. Insurance steps up to a strong plan approaching international cover. There's real room for frequent weekend trips — Essaouira, the Atlas Mountains, or cheap hops to Europe out of Marrakech-Menara airport.

housing.description: Luxury apartment or a small single-occupant Palmeraie/golf-zone villa with pool

dining.description: Near-daily dining, much of it high-end

entertainment.description: Clubs, spas, events, more frequent travel

domesticHelp.description: Part-time housekeeper a few days a week

luxuryExtras.description: Private club membership, spa/wellness, concierge, upgraded travel

5M.lifestyle: Marrakech luxury tuned for one — a designer apartment or a small single-occupant villa with its own pool on the Palmeraie or golf-zone fringe. A part-time housekeeper comes a few days a week, dining out is near-daily and much of it high-end, and a car with a part-time driver on call handles transport. Healthcare is a top-tier private/international plan covering the best facilities. Spa circuits, club memberships, and more frequent travel round it out, all sized to a single person.

housing.description: Luxury villa or grand restored riad, staffed, scaled to one occupant

dining.description: Lavish, near-daily fine dining and entertaining

healthcare.description: International concierge cover with medevac to Europe

transportation.description: Car(s) plus running costs (full-time driver under domesticHelp)

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper and cook scaled to ONE home

luxuryExtras.description: Club memberships, spa/wellness, concierge, curated travel

10M.lifestyle: The ceiling of living exceptionally well in Marrakech as one person — a staffed luxury villa or grand restored riad with pool and gardens, kept by a full-time housekeeper and cook scaled to a single home. A car and full-time driver are at your disposal, dining is essentially catered or at the best tables nightly, and healthcare is an international concierge plan with medevac to Europe. The discretionary budget funds constant European travel, entertaining, and spa and club memberships. Deliberately below a family palace-estate FatFIRE, because a solo resident simply can't consume a household's worth of space or staff.
